haar_and_fourier_theorem.global_spectrum: the orthogonal complement of k=0 has Lebesgue spectrum of countably infinite multiplicity
haar_and_fourier_theorem.haar: T_alpha is an invertible determinant-one affine toral map and preserves normalized Haar measure
haar_and_fourier_theorem.pure_point_sector: k=0 is spanned by eigenvectors e_(m,0) with eigenvalues exp(2*pi*i*m*alpha)
haar_and_fourier_theorem.shift_sectors: for k!=0, residues m mod |k| give |k| invariant weighted bilateral shifts, each unitarily equivalent to the bilateral shift

iterate_theorem.fixed_point_obstruction: a fixed point of T_alpha^n would force n*alpha=0 mod 1, impossible for irrational alpha
iterate_theorem.formula: T_alpha^n(x,y)=(x+n*alpha, y+n*x+binom(n,2)*alpha) mod 1 for every n>=1

nonclaims: prime-like primitive orbits from an empty periodic ledger
an ordinary Fredholm determinant for the non-trace-class Koopman operator
a target divisor, functional equation, counting law, or continuation match
arithmetic local factors, Euler factors, root numbers, or automorphy
a Hilbert--Polya operator, Route-B authorization, novelty priority, or external peer review

progress_and_boundary.progress: proves an all-irrational-parameter iterate law, empty periodic ledger, complete Fourier-sector spectral decomposition, exact reversor, and sharp determinant obstruction
progress_and_boundary.route_a_obstruction: the empty periodic data make zeta_AM=1; there is no primitive-orbit carrier, target divisor comparison, or target global analytic comparison
progress_and_boundary.sentinel_boundary: finite rows only regression-test formulas proved symbolically; they do not establish irrationality or extrapolate the theorem

reversibility_and_operator_boundary.antiunitary: Theta f=conjugate(f after R) is involutive and Theta*U*Theta=U^(-1)
reversibility_and_operator_boundary.fredholm_boundary: zU is not trace class for z!=0, so the ordinary Fredholm determinant det(I-zU) is unavailable
reversibility_and_operator_boundary.noncompact: U maps a Fourier orthonormal basis bijectively to another orthonormal basis and is not compact
reversibility_and_operator_boundary.reversor: R(x,y)=(alpha-x,y) mod 1 is involutive and R*T_alpha*R=T_alpha^(-1)
reversibility_and_operator_boundary.schatten: U belongs to no finite Schatten class
reversibility_and_operator_boundary.unitary: U is the same-clock Haar Koopman unitary

source_lock.allowed_data: the frozen toral affine map and source-derived Fourier indices
source_lock.arithmetic_origin: none; alpha is an arbitrary irrational source parameter and no prime or prime-power structure is intrinsic
source_lock.cutoff: all-parameter proof; finite exact regression uses n<=32, |m|<=12 and |k|<=8 on the Fourier grid, plus 0<|k|<=12 in the sector sentinel
source_lock.determinant_convention: Artin--Mazur zeta from finite fixed-point counts; ordinary Fredholm determinant only when defined
source_lock.forbidden_data: target zero or prime tables, arithmetic local data, Euler factors, root numbers, automorphy, Hilbert--Polya operators, and Route-B inputs
source_lock.normalization: normalized Haar measure and Fourier basis e_(m,k)=exp(2*pi*i*(m*x+k*y))
source_lock.object: Furstenberg skew shift T_alpha(x,y)=(x+alpha,y+x) on the two-torus
source_lock.precision: exact integer affine coefficients and formal irrational alpha
